Title: [Logout] - Happy Path - User Logout Flow
Description: This test case verifies the complete user logout process. The objective is to ensure that a logged-in user can successfully terminate their session from the main application interface and is securely redirected to the public login page.
Precondition: The user has an active, authenticated session and is currently on any page within the application (e.g., https://app.datascend.net/dashboard/welcome).
Steps:
Locate the user profile dropdown trigger element in the top-right corner of the main navigation bar. Perform a click action on this element.
Within the visible dropdown menu, locate the "Logout" element and perform a click action.
Once the page has finished loading, check the browser's current URL.
Attempt to navigate directly to a protected internal URL, such as the welcome dashboard.
(for example: Try to use the endpoint https://app.datascend.net/dashboard)
ExpectedResult:
A dropdown menu appears below the user profile element. This menu must contain a clickable element with the following fields:
Profile
Settings
Change Password
"Logout".
The request is sent and the backend's response is awaited. The browser begins browsing.
The browser's URL must exactly match the login page URL: https://app.datascend.net/auth/login. The content displayed must be the "Iniciar Sesión" form.
The application should block access and redirect the user back to the login page, confirming the session was properly invalidated.
